---
title: "Mann-Whitney Comparison with Ties"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)
library(knitr)

cardinality <- sum
ustat <- function(a, b, fun)
  cardinality(outer(a, b, fun))

hook(ustat)
hook(cardinality(.A), abs(.A))
hook(n_a, subscript(n, "A"))
hook(n_b, subscript(n, "B"))
hook(u, U)
hook(as.character(.X), .X)

task <- "mannwhitney6"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package = "mistakes"))

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_a <- sample(20:40, 1)
  n_b <- sample(20:40, 1)

  x <- sample(1:20, n_a + n_b, replace=TRUE)

  a <- sort(x[1:n_a])
  b <- sort(x[n_a + 1:n_b])

  wins_a <- sum(outer(a, b, ">"))
  ties   <- sum(outer(a, b, "=="))
  wins_b <- sum(outer(a, b, "<"))

  if(ties < 1) 
    next

  if(wins_a < 2 || wins_b < 2)
    next

  #To avoid duplicate answers
  if(wins_a == wins_b) 
    next
  if(wins_a == wins_b + ties/2) 
    next  
  if(wins_a + ties/2 == wins_b ) 
    next

  Q <- quote(search(mannwhitney6, mannwhitney6(a, b, n_a, n_b), .S, .R, .P, .E))

  S <- findall(Q, options = list(preproc = as.rolog), env = environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task = task, S)

sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```

Question
========

In a clinical trial, patients were randomized to either a new therapy for anxiety (Therapy A) 
or treatment as usual (Therapy B), with `r n_a` and `r n_b` patients in each treatment arm, 
respectively. At the end of the treatment, anxiety symptoms were assessed 
using the Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) questionnaire, 
with lower scores indicating less severe anxiety symptoms.
Comparing each patient's GAD-7 score from Treatment A with each patient's score 
from Treatment B resulted in `r n_a * n_b` pairwise comparisons. 
Patients receiving Therapy A had lower scores in `r wins_a` comparisons, 
patients receiving Treatment B had lower scores in `r wins_b` comparisons, 
and `r ties` comparisons were ties.

Estimate the competing probability for Therapy A.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The competing probability is calculated by dividing the $U$-statistic 
by the number of pairwise comparisons: `r t$solution`


```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
